main.description: A federation relationship a space has been asked for — one record per federating space, written to the receiving space's repo. Removing the relationship deletes it.

federatingSpace.description: The space that asked. The same DID the record key names.

requestedBy.description: The admin who sent the request.

status.description: The receiving space's answer. Absent while the request is unanswered.

message.description: The note sent with the request or the answer.
